entries.en: This is fascinating, but we don't have time to chat.
Are you telling me I shouldn't kill these things?
I didn't see her when I was there.
Obviously, they were wrong.
We'll take care of her later.
They brought it here to wake it up?
They should've destroyed it. Why hatch it?
I understand that we'll be dead soon. Talk fast.
Mira said there was a "Tartakovsky" in here.
If by "secure" you mean "shoot every monster I see," sure.
I have not so much time. I die under ice. Is not so bad death. I am born in Arhangelsk. There is closure.
Nah, nah. What I ask for, eh? A strong vodka is nice, but it would just leak out.
I am certain my body screams bloody murder. Shock is maybe not all so bad, eh?
Code is 875-020-079. You tell Mira that, then tell her, "Code Omega local execution." Everything run automatic from there.
You leave quickly, yes? I will become puddle of goo, but I am thinking I will not care so much.
Ehh. This is all for me, I am thinking. I try to think of good, inspiring last words. Maybe something li-- ahhhh...
I am feeling not so well.
No. I am sorry, but this will not work.
These rachni are beyond saving. It is a sad thing, but they must be euthanized. I am thinking that the neutron purge must be set off.
Ehh. I do not want so much to be here myself. But the Mira system, she will not let you leave.
Is failsafe, you understand? You leave without arranging to eliminate rachni, maybe they spread.
Sure, sure. I wait here. I am not so much good for searching now, yes? Haha.
It creates burst of neutron radiation. Kills everything within the station. Things beyond get genetic damage of varying degree.
Ehh. Actually, I was to tell you the opposite.
Is there anything we can do for you?
You don't look good.
I need the purge code, Tartakovsky.
I don't have time for this. If the Matriarch isn't here, we're leaving.
Once the purge is armed we'll have to fight our way out. Give us a minute to patch up and rearm.
I'm not familiar with the purge system.
How do we set off the purge?
Asari? I have not seen one.
Wait. Is there an asari Matriarch here?
Can we help?
Aren't you in pain?
I didn't see a queen there.
That didn't work.
We'll kill her too.
We can save them.
We're running out of time.
Neutron purge?
Just tell me how.
To hell with this.
Give us a minute.
The purge code.
You're Tartakovsky?
If you mean "exterminate."
You let them loose?
Talk fast, then.
That egg was ancient!
They hatched it?
I would have smashed it.
Mother always say I would meet a bad end.
That is so. Billions of lives lost in that war, on both sides.
Rachni? The krogan wiped them out a thousand years ago.
She must be at Rift Station, Commander.
She is safe, then. At Rift Station.
She must be at Rift Station, then.
This is not important. You must be listening.
Queens can lay eggs in hours, and have a colony in days. This is how they spread so quickly.
Hold on. Don't you need a male to get eggs?
Separating them from their mother didn't work.
What about a male?
The rachni aren't obedient.
We'll kill the queen too.
Wait. Wait!
What does the purge do?
How do I trigger the purge?
Arming controls are nearby. All you do is insert the key. Then I will give Mira destruct co--. UH!
They got what was coming.
Your experiment failed.
Just wait here.
Give us a minute to prepare.
